description: Declarative, re-runnable import rules for skills/. `python tools/skill_import.py` materialises these rules into skills/ and rewrites SOURCES.json + INDEX.md; `--check` re-derives the same selection from the pinned upstream commit, re-hashes every imported file and fails when anything drifted. Edit this file (not SOURCES.json) when importing, re-pinning, normalising or dropping a source.
snapshot_base_note: A relative `snapshot` path is tried against the workspace root, the repository's parent and the repository itself (first existing wins) so the rules survive being cloned next to Security-LabData; pin it with --snapshot-root when the layout differs.

sources.label: ctf-skills
sources.selection: every top-level directory of the snapshot that ships a SKILL.md (11 of them), copied verbatim

sources.label: awesome-dfir-skills
sources.selection: explicit allowlist of 8 upstream skill directories under skills/<category>/; the entry file is renamed to SKILL.md and its frontmatter normalised (comment lines dropped, name/description unquoted, name set to the local directory name)

sources.label: Anthropic Cybersecurity Skills
sources.selection: SKILL.md frontmatter: subdomain in {digital-forensics, threat-hunting, incident-response} OR tags include memory-forensics (132 of 818 upstream skills)
